text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Friday.
- One quarter of Croatia's citizens suffer from alcoholism.
- 1,000 Croats want to settle in the liberated areas.
- As of January 1997 salaries to go up and to have no restrictions.
- Interior minister Ivan Jarnjak on a one-day visit to Belgrade.
- Parliament votes to abolish military courts.
- Are managerial loans to be proclaimed null and void?
- London World Tourist Fair: Croatia's tourism offer on display. 100,000 Britons expected to visit the Croatian coast in 1998. -- Zagreb Newsrooms, 385-1-4557075
